name: snapshot
description: Read the complete current context and reference catalogue. No discovery; usage is cumulative.

name: inspect
description: Read the formula, provenance, and relationships of one active reference. Does not search.

name: expand_action
description: Expose enabling conditions of one encountered action under a work budget. Does not discover or queue instances.

name: make_term
description: Type-check and intern one ground SMT-LIB term using declared symbols. Does not assert anything.

name: instantiate
description: Supply complete correlated substitutions for registered schemas. Construct, validate, and queue instances without searching or installing.

name: search
description: Assisted mode only. Delegate bounded ordinary discovery; append candidates and preserve their origins. Does not install or check the solver.

name: advance
description: Rank and install queued candidates, then check the solver. Never discovers candidates or falls back to search.

name: stop
description: End this intervention inconclusively; return accounting without asserting success.
